subject: design-technology
title: Evaluating Designs
welcome_lead: How well does it meet the spec — and what to improve.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T: evaluation, peer review, final review.
final_note: Honest evaluation makes the next version better.

concepts.def: Judging how well a design works.
Feedback from classmates or other designers.

walkthroughs.body_html: Evaluation tests each point in your specification. Did it hold 1.5 kg? Did it cost under £10? Mark each as met, partly met, or missed.
Peer review means classmates evaluate your work — fresh eyes catch problems you missed. User feedback from your target audience is even better.
Write a list of modifications: what to change, why, and how. That's your starting point for the next iteration. Showing what you'd do next is mature designing.
